NONE: › a person, especially a man, who is not attractive and is awkward or socially embarrassing
討厭的人，笨蛋（尤指男子）
› a person who is extremely interested in one subject, especially computers, and knows a lot of facts about it
對（尤指電腦）入迷的人

example: He was a real nerd in high school - I can't believe he's so handsome now.
他上高中的時候呆頭呆腦——我簡直無法相信他現在這麼帥。
I'm a real grammar nerd.
我真的是一個文法迷。

C: C2 [ C ] a group of long, thin fibres (= structures like threads) that carry information or instructions between the brain and other parts of the body

U: C2 [ U ] the courage or confidence necessary to do something difficult, unpleasant, or rude

NONE: B2 worry or anxiety about something that is going to happen
緊張不安；提心吊膽
B2 to annoy someone a lot
使（某人）心煩
B2 the ability to be calm in difficult situations
在困難的局面下保持冷靜的能力

S or U: C2 [ S or U ] the rudeness to do something that you know will upset other people

NONE: › to make yourself brave enough to do something
鼓足勇氣

example: the optic nerve
視神經
a spinal nerve
脊神經
It takes a lot of nerve to be a bomb disposal expert.
當拆彈專家需要極大勇氣。
I wanted to ask her out, but I lost my nerve and couldn't go through with it.
我曾想約她出來，但我失去了勇氣，說不出口。
[ + to infinitive ] I didn't have the nerve to tell him what I really thought of his suggestion.
我沒膽量告訴他我對他的建議的真實看法。
I never suffer from nerves when I'm speaking in public.
我當眾講話從不緊張。
She was a bundle of nerves (= very nervous) before the audition.
她試演之前非常緊張。
I always have a cigarette to calm/steady my nerves (= make me less nervous) before I go on stage.
我在上臺前總會抽支煙來穩定自己的情緒。
We really got on each other's nerves when we were living together.
我們住在一起時確實鬧得不可開交。
Please stop making that noise! It really gets on my nerves.
請不要再發出那種噪聲了！它吵得我很心煩。
You need a cool head and steady nerves for this job.
那位元工作需要冷靜的頭腦和堅強的神經。
[ + to infinitive ] She's late for work every day, but she still has the nerve to lecture me about punctuality.
她天天遲到，居然還有臉教訓我要準時。
That man has some nerve! He's always blaming me for things that are his fault.
那人真是無恥！有些事明明是他的過錯，他卻總來責備我。
UK also That man has such a nerve!
那人真是無恥！
She drove the car into a tree and then told me it was my fault for not concentrating, of all the nerve!
她開車撞到樹，卻怪我精神不集中，真虧她說得出來！
[ + to infinitive ] It took her several months before she eventually nerved herself (up) to invite him to her house.
她過了好幾個月才終於鼓足勇氣邀請他去自己家。

NONE: › a cell that carries information between the brain and other parts of the body
神經元

example: Synonym
neuron

NONE: › a place from which an organization or activity is controlled or managed
中樞；核心；控制中心

example: The Pentagon is the nerve centre of the US Armed Forces.
五角大樓是美國軍方的神經中樞。

NONE: › a poisonous gas, often used as a weapon, that damages the nerves
神經性毒氣（常用作武器）
› Something that is nerve-racking is difficult to do and causes a lot of worry for the person involved in it.
傷腦筋的；使人心煩的

example: My wedding was the most nerve-racking thing I've ever experienced.
我的婚禮是我經歷過最傷腦筋的事情。

NONE: › calm and confident about something difficult that you are doing
沉著的；鎮定自若的
B1 worried and anxious
擔心的；緊張不安的
› relating to the nerves
神經的；神經系統的

example: Do you feel/get nervous during exams?
考試時你感到緊張嗎？
I was too nervous to speak.
我緊張得說不出話來。
She's always been nervous around dogs.
她一直很怕狗。
I was very nervous about driving again after the accident.
那次事故之後，我很怕再開車。
He had/was of a nervous disposition.
他是個神經質的人。
He suffers from a nervous disorder.
他患有神經紊亂症。

NONE: › a period of mental illness, usually without a physical cause, that results in anxiety, difficulty in sleeping and thinking clearly, a loss of confidence and hope, and a feeling of great sadness
神經失常；神經衰弱

example: He suffered a nervous breakdown in his twenties.
他二十多歲時曾患神經衰弱。

NONE: › An animal's or person's nervous system consists of its brain and all the nerves in its body that together make movement and feeling possible by sending messages around the body.
神經系統
B2 feeling or showing that you are worried and anxious
擔憂地，焦慮地

example: He looked nervously over his shoulder, making sure no one else was listening.
他緊張地回頭望了一下，以確定沒有其他人在聽。

NONE: C1 a feeling of worry and anxiety
擔憂，焦慮

example: There is growing nervousness about the possibility of a war.
擔心爆發戰爭的緊張情緒不斷加劇。

NONE: › a Latin word meaning "nerve" or "group of nerves", used in medical names and descriptions
（拉丁語，用於醫學用語）神經
› worried
緊張不安的

example: I'm always nervy before an exam.
我考試前總是很緊張。
